# scaffolding_node_status (Data Source)

Reports runtime CPU, memory, kernel, and root-filesystem usage for a single Proxmox VE node (`GET /nodes/{node}/status`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Name of the PVE node to query.

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (Number) Current CPU usage fraction (0.0–1.0).
- `id` (String) Static identifier equal to the node name.
- `kernel` (String) Running kernel version.
- `level` (String) Node capability level (`c` for current).
- `maxcpu` (Number) Number of CPU cores.
- `maxmem` (Number) Total memory in bytes.
- `mem` (Number) Used memory in bytes.
- `pveversion` (String) Installed PVE package version.
- `rootfs_free` (Number) Root filesystem free in bytes.
- `rootfs_total` (Number) Root filesystem capacity in bytes.
- `rootfs_used` (Number) Root filesystem used in bytes.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime in seconds.
